turns.thought:
Yes — absolutely, turn Airplane Mode off. That's very likely the remaining cause of your "No Service."

**Why:** Airplane Mode disables all of your phone's wireless radios, including the cellular radio. While it's on, you won't get any signal bars, calls, texts, or mobile data — regardless of the fact that your line is active. On our end, your line 555-123-2002 is confirmed **Active**, so this is a device-level setting.

**How to turn it off (either method):**
1. **Quick Settings:** Swipe down from the top of your screen (swipe down twice on some phones) to open the full Quick Settings panel, then tap the **Airplane Mode / ✈️ icon** so it turns gray or un-highlights.
2. **Settings menu:** Open **Settings → Network & internet** (or **Connections** on some phones), then toggle **Airplane mode** to **Off**.

**After you do that:**
- Give your phone about 30–60 seconds to reconnect to the network.
- Check your status bar again — you should now see signal bars (📶) and a network type such as 5G or 4G.

**One more thing to check:** Make sure your mobile data switch is also ON. If you see "📵 Data Disabled" in the status bar, go to **Settings → Network & internet → Mobile network** (or **SIMs**) and turn **Mobile data** ON.

Let me know what your status bar shows after you turn Airplane Mode off. If you're still seeing "No Signal" or no bars, I'll keep troubleshooting with you.
